# Owned Map

> Owned Map is a Spanish-language AI SEO agency (AEO and GEO). It makes a company's website and brand citable by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews, so that those assistants recommend it to buyers. Garantía: +30% de crecimiento en 90 días o trabajamos gratis hasta que se consiga (para clientes cualificados de los planes Inicial y Crecimiento, con condiciones).

Clients get a visibility dashboard (a globe of zones, tracked questions per AI assistant, and the work done each month); the agency manages everything. Calls and the first visibility report are free.

## Plans (euros, VAT not included; paying yearly is 30% cheaper)
- Inicial: 997 € per month. 31 articles a month, technical and structured-data work, tracking of key questions in the AI assistants, dashboard, monthly report.
- Crecimiento: 2.999 € per month. 62 articles a month, new commercial pages, a monthly authority campaign, weekly report.
- Dominio: 10.000 € per month. All the articles needed to rank fast and safely (up to 300 a month), several languages, founder-led strategy, competitor measurement, press and editorial placements.
- Initial term of three months; afterwards cancel with one month's notice.
